title: Efficient Photogeneration of Oxidizing (Compound II-like) Species of Semisynthetic Myoglobin Appending Ruthenium Tris(2,2′-bipyridine)
abstract: Abstract                An efficient photogeneration method for an oxidizing active species of semisynthetic myoglobin bearing ruthenium tris(2,2′-bipyridine) (Ru(bpy)3) through intramolecular electron abstraction is described.
